SI Pratiksha, PS   Respondent No.2 i  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD  OR % 12.08.2024 1.

The Petitioners have approached this Court for quashing FIR No.407/2020, registered at Police Station Prem Nagar for offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the Parties have entered into an amicable settlement.
2. It is stated by the Respondent No.2/complainant that she has not received the balance amount of Rs.90,000/- as per the settlement.
Though a Demand Draft of Rs.90,000/- has been given in Court but the same was issued on 16.04.2024 and has already expired.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J AUGUST 12, 2024 S. Zakir
